name: DomainNet: Multi-Source Domain Adaptation Benchmark
description: DomainNet is an extensive dataset for multi-source domain adaptation and transfer learning in computer vision, created by Boston University. It comprises 586,575 images across 345 object categories spanning 6 distinct visual domains: Clipart, Infograph, Painting, Quickdraw, Real, and Sketch. It serves as a gold standard for evaluating model robustness across significant domain shifts.
